; The installer gates exact firmware and applies after the existing AppLoad.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.SidebarFoldout#integrationsFoldout
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: wereadDownloaderSidebar
                objectName: "wereadDownloaderSidebar"
                text: "微信读书下载"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/import"
                highlighted: Downloader.opened
                onTriggered: { root.toggle(); Downloader.openPage() }
                Layout.preferredHeight: Common.Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                Component.onCompleted: Downloader.placeBelowAppLoad(wereadDownloaderSidebar)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE Background#root > FocusScope#rootItem
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: wereadDownloaderHost
                anchors.fill: parent
                // Native VirtualKeyboardWindow uses z=10000 in the same scene.
                z: 9999
                visible: Downloader.opened
                property bool readingWifiConnected: LinkProvider.isOnline
                onReadingWifiConnectedChanged: Downloader.setReadingWifiConnected(readingWifiConnected)
                property bool readingLocked: root.passcodeHandler?.userLocked ?? true
                onReadingLockedChanged: Downloader.setReadingLocked(readingLocked)
                onVisibleChanged: { if (!visible && Downloader.opened) Downloader.closePage() }
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    Downloader.attachSettings(Settings);
                    Downloader.setReadingWifiConnected(readingWifiConnected);
                    Downloader.setReadingApplicationActive(Qt.application.state === Qt.ApplicationActive);
                    Downloader.setReadingLocked(readingLocked);
                }
                Loader {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    active: Downloader.opened
                    source: "qrc:/weread-downloader/DownloaderPage.qml"
                }
                Connections {
                    target: Downloader
                    function onRecentReadRequested(uuid) {
                        let entry = Library.entryForId(uuid);
                        if (entry && typeof entry.markOpened === "function") entry.markOpened();
                    }
                    function onRestoreRequested(uuid, page, bookId) {
                        let entry = Library.entryForId(uuid);
                        if (!entry || page < 0 || page >= entry.pageCount) {
                            Downloader.completeRestore(bookId, false);
                            return;
                        }
                        LibraryController.setLastOpenedPage(entry.id, page);
                        Qt.callLater(function() { Downloader.completeRestore(bookId, entry.lastOpenedPage === page); });
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: PowerManager
                    function onPowerButtonShortPress() { Downloader.closePage() }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: Qt.application
                    function onStateChanged() {
                        Downloader.setReadingApplicationActive(Qt.application.state === Qt.ApplicationActive);
                        // A system input-method window can temporarily deactivate Xochitl.
                        if (Qt.application.state === Qt.ApplicationHidden || Qt.application.state === Qt.ApplicationSuspended) Downloader.closePage()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: wereadReadingTimeTracker
                property string uuid: ""
                property int lastPage: -1
                function updatePause() {
                    Downloader.setReadingDeviceSleeping(root.inSuspend);
                    Downloader.setReadingSuspended(root.inSuspend || !root.documentLoaded || !root.visible || root.subDialogOpen || root.fullscreenSubDialogOpen);
                }
                Connections {
                    target: root
                    function onDocumentOpened(document) {
                        wereadReadingTimeTracker.uuid = String(document.id);
                        wereadReadingTimeTracker.lastPage = root.currentPage;
                        Downloader.readingStarted(wereadReadingTimeTracker.uuid, root.currentPage);
                        wereadReadingTimeTracker.updatePause();
                    }
                    function onDocumentClosed() { Downloader.readingStopped(wereadReadingTimeTracker.lastPage);wereadReadingTimeTracker.uuid = "";wereadReadingTimeTracker.lastPage = -1; }
                    function onCurrentPageChanged() {
                        if (root.document && String(root.document.id) === wereadReadingTimeTracker.uuid && root.currentPage >= 0) {
                            wereadReadingTimeTracker.lastPage = root.currentPage;
                            Downloader.readingActivity();
                        }
                    }
                    function onInSuspendChanged() { wereadReadingTimeTracker.updatePause(); }
                    function onDocumentLoadedChanged() { wereadReadingTimeTracker.updatePause(); }
                    function onFullscreenSubDialogOpenChanged() { wereadReadingTimeTracker.updatePause(); }
                    function onSubDialogOpenChanged() { wereadReadingTimeTracker.updatePause(); }
                    function onVisibleChanged() { wereadReadingTimeTracker.updatePause(); }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/ContentEntriesGridItem.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE MouseArea#gridItem > Item#preview > Rectangle#thumbnail
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: wereadNativeBadgeLoader
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                anchors.rightMargin: 10
                anchors.bottomMargin: Math.max(archiveWarning.visible ? archiveWarning.height : 0, inactiveWarning.visible ? inactiveWarning.height : 0) + 10
                width: 48
                height: 48
                property string badgeStatus: {
                    const revision = Downloader.nativeBookRevision;
                    return gridItem.entry ? Downloader.nativeBookBadge(String(gridItem.entry.id)) : "";
                }
                active: badgeStatus !== ""
                visible: active
                source: "qrc:/weread-downloader/WeReadBadge.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    item.badgeStatus = Qt.binding(function() { return wereadNativeBadgeLoader.badgeStatus; });
                    console.info("WereadDownloaderPlugin: native-badge-ready");
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentPageSlider.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE PageSlider#pageSlider
        REPLACE anchors WITH { anchors {
        left: parent.left
        leftMargin: toolbar.shown && toolbar.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Left ? toolbar.innerWidth : 0
        rightMargin: toolbar.shown && toolbar.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Right ? toolbar.innerWidth : 0
        right: parent.right
        bottom: parent.bottom
        alignWhenCentered: true
        bottomMargin: {
            let margin = 50;
            // Add space for the page label if the notification bar and page label are visible
            if (documentView.notificationBar && documentView.pageLabel &&
                    documentView.notificationBar.visible && documentView.pageLabel.visible) {
                margin += documentView.pageLabel.height;
            }

            // Add space for the toolbar if it's shown at the bottom
            if (toolbar && toolbar.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Bottom && toolbar.shown) {
                margin += toolbar.innerHeight;
            }
            return margin + (Downloader.readingSessionStatus !== "" ? 104 : 0);
        }
    } }
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Text {
                objectName: "wereadReadingSessionFooter"
                anchors.top: parent.bottom
                anchors.topMargin: 20
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.leftMargin: ArkControls.Values.spacing.xlarge
                anchors.rightMargin: ArkControls.Values.spacing.xlarge
                text: Downloader.readingSessionStatus
                visible: text !== "" && !pageSlider.pageThumbnailVisible
                font.pixelSize: 24
                color: "black"
                wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
